verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is a CLI-first tool (official CLI docs). The evidence shows clear automation primitives: plans saved with -out and applied later, speculative plans for code-review pipelines, machine-readable -json/-json-into output for tests, environment-variable configuration (TF_ENCRYPTION), an official OCI container image, and a nightlies JSON feed for tooling. missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive flags (e.g. auto-approve or input suppression), a dedicated CI/automation guide, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
